dct_description_sm: Most maps in this collection before 1800 are photocopies or facsimiles.

Most maps in this collection before 1800 are photocopies or facsimiles. This record covers single maps covering regions of Pennsylvania, which are not represented in the LC database by separate catalog records. This collection includes single printed maps and photocopies of printed or manuscript single maps and may also include some multi-sheet single maps, plates from atlases, books or periodicals, and printed facsimiles. These maps show regions, such as mountains, rivers and lakes. To request a specific map or for more information, contact a reference librarian in the Geography & Map Division (202) 707-6277 or through the "Ask a librarian" link through the Geography & Map Division website https://ask.loc.gov/map-geography/.
